name: util_pgou_stats
_description: GET stats agregadas de municipal_pgou_rules: total_rules, total_municipios, rules_with_embedding, rules_pending_embedding, rules_pending_searchable + breakdown por municipio_slug. Usado para verificar progreso del backfill.

parameters.query:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*)::int                                          AS total_rules,
    COUNT(DISTINCT municipio_slug)::int                    AS total_municipios,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE embedding IS NOT NULL)::int     AS rules_with_embedding,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE embedding IS NULL)::int         AS rules_pending_embedding,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE searchable_text IS NULL)::int   AS rules_pending_searchable
  FROM municipal_pgou_rules
),
by_muni AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    'slug', municipio_slug,
    'nombre', municipio_nombre,
    'rules', cnt,
    'with_embedding', emb
  ) ORDER BY municipio_slug) AS per_municipio
  FROM (
    SELECT municipio_slug, municipio_nombre,
           COUNT(*)::int                                       AS cnt,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE embedding IS NOT NULL)::int  AS emb
    FROM municipal_pgou_rules
    GROUP BY municipio_slug, municipio_nombre
  ) g
)
SELECT (SELECT row_to_json(s) FROM stats s)         AS stats,
       (SELECT per_municipio FROM by_muni)          AS per_municipio
